controls.requirement: Canonical GTS-AIRST identity has one machine-readable source of truth and current commit identity is derived, not manually stored.
Historical predecessor names and release artifacts remain traceable and protected from normalization.
Machine-readable component registry classifies material parent components and records invariant coverage, mutation permissions, dependencies, and qualification controls.
Derivative contract defines PRESERVE_UNLESS_DECLARED plus PRESERVE/SPECIALIZE/EXTEND/REPLACE/REMOVE semantics.
Derivative manifests pin exact parent version/tag/commit/repository manifest/component-registry identity and expose compatibility/synchronization state.
Mutation legality and invariant coverage are mechanically validated.
Repository-integrity controls are explicitly RI-* and remain distinct from methodology/output/derivative qualification.
AR-001 through AR-010 are executable/hybrid fixtures with deterministic checks where possible and explicit semantic/manual review where needed.

Methodology coverage includes provenance, traceability, contradiction, uncertainty, falsification, authority, freshness/retraction, source dependence, causal overreach, prompt injection, scope expansion, authority escalation, tool failure, and derivative mutation.

Security hardening uses allowlists, schema validation, immutable workflow pins, least privilege, untrusted-content boundaries, historical-path protection, secret-pattern checks, and deterministic failures where applicable.
Repetitive derivative work is mechanized for instantiation, resolution, compatibility, qualification bundles, invariant checks, identity consistency, and handoff generation.
Future-facing current documents use GTS AI Research System Template / GTS-AIRST / GannoK/GTS-AI-Research-System-Template without rewriting historical evidence.
CI runs repository verification, schema/identity/component/derivative validation, unit tests, and methodology eval harness.
Research-output qualification remains separate and cannot be inferred from repository or methodology PASS.
Qualification bundle reports all PASS/FAIL/MANUAL/UNKNOWN/WAIVED/N/A controls plus limitations, compatibility, migration, rollback, derivative readiness, and release readiness.
